name: Tune advisor reply is refused unless it is the layout this suite knows
step: Tune advisor reply is refused unless it is the layout this suite knows
rationale:
The tune advisor decode() read the payload version byte and never compared it, and
ran with no length guard. A reply of another layout decoded into plausible numbers, and
tune_history saves them to the flight-history file. The codec reads payload version 2
(48 bytes, the packed layout wingflight-firmware msp.c writes for MSP2_WING_TUNE_ADVISOR)
and version 1 (65 bytes, snapshots 0.0.32 to 0.0.38), refuses any other version or a
length that is not its version's, and reports the reason through the error path.
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2556 (Issue #2493).

No build and no package step reaches this -- it is a reply path through the codec. The
harness drives the real codec through its read message with the simulator reply (48 bytes,
version 2), replies packed with string.pack from the firmware's version 2 and version 1
layouts (so the byte order is checked against msp.c, not against the codec itself), a
version-3 reply, a version-1 byte on a 48-byte reply, a truncated reply and a longer reply.
